# Control SVG snapshots (BLUE20 layer 3)

One SVG per control, named by its **canonical name**. Each control appears twice:
`<name>.svg` is the dark appearance, `<name>.light.svg` the light one.

## Why the pair matters

Two files that are byte-identical mean the control renders the same in both
appearances, so it does not respond to the theme. The files exist so that is
visible to a person, not only to the `P3` assertion in
`tools/check_control_rendering.sh`.

## Regenerating

```bash
cargo run --no-default-features --features desktop --example export_control_svgs
```

`tools/check_svg_snapshots.sh` regenerates the set and requires it to match the
committed files byte for byte, so **any** change to a control's drawing shows up as
a diff. Do not hand-edit these files: a hand-edit is reverted by the next run and
fails the gate in between.

## Adding a control

1. Register it in `src/widget/capability/registration.rs` (capability + constructor).
2. Re-run the exporter above; the new control's two files and its index row are
generated automatically — this list is derived from the registry, never typed.
3. Run `bash tools/check_svg_snapshots.sh`.
